note: Report-summary Canada batch: 12 questions answerable from the summary documents ingested with tag claude_report_summaries_canada_20261105 (20 Canadian critical-mineral projects). Truth from the report / release text, written before any system was asked.

questions.question: What did PMET Resources' feasibility study for the CV5 pegmatite at Shaakichiuwaanaan in Quebec find?

facts: Maiden Probable Mineral Reserve of 84.3 Mt at 1.26% Li2O
After-tax NPV8 of about US$1.19 billion (about C$1.59 billion) and after-tax IRR about 18.1% at a long-term price of US$1,221/t SC5.5
Total development capital about C$1,978 million (about C$1,510 million net of pre-production credits)
About 20-year mine life, roughly 800,000 tpa of spodumene concentrate
truth.source: PMET CV5 lithium-only FS release, 20 Oct 2025

questions.question: What are the reserves and economics of Critical Elements' Rose lithium-tantalum project?

facts: Probable Mineral Reserve of 26.3 Mt at 0.87% Li2O and 138 ppm Ta2O5
After-tax NPV8 of about C$2,851 million (about US$2.2 billion) and after-tax IRR of 65.7%
Life of mine of about 19 years at 1.61 Mtpa ore processing
From the 2023 NI 43-101 feasibility study (WSP / InnovExplo)

questions.question: How big is Canada Nickel's Crawford nickel project and what does the feasibility study say about its economics?

facts: Proven and Probable reserves of about 1,715 Mt at 0.22% Ni (994 Mt Proven at 0.24% Ni and 721 Mt Probable at 0.20% Ni)
After-tax NPV8 of US$2,475 million and after-tax IRR of 17.1%
Initial capital cost of about C$2,556 million (60 kt/d start, expanding to 120 kt/d)
Feasibility-study life of mine of 41 years

questions.question: What are the reserve and economic figures for NexGen's Arrow uranium deposit (Rook I project)?

facts: Probable Mineral Reserve of about 4.58 Mt at 2.37% U3O8 (239.6 Mlb U3O8)
Post-tax NPV8 of C$3,465 million and post-tax IRR of 52.4% at US$50/lb U3O8
Pre-production capital of about C$1.3 billion (C$1,299.9M including pre-commitment costs)
11-year mine life producing 233.6 Mlb of recovered U3O8

questions.question: What did Denison's feasibility study find for the Phoenix in-situ recovery uranium operation at Wheeler River?

facts: Phoenix Proven and Probable reserves of about 219 kt at 11.7% U3O8 (about 56.7 Mlb recoverable U3O8)
After-tax NPV8 of about C$1.43 billion and IRR of 82.3%
Initial capital cost of about C$419.4 million
From the 2023 NI 43-101 technical report (effective 23 June 2023)

questions.question: What are the reserves and returns for Nouveau Monde Graphite's Matawinie mine in Quebec?

facts: Proven and Probable reserves of about 61.7 Mt at 4.23% graphitic carbon
After-tax NPV8 of about C$238 million and after-tax IRR of 15.8%
Initial capital cost of about C$421 million for the mine and concentrator
25-year life of mine

questions.question: What reserves and economics does Western Copper and Gold report for the Casino project in Yukon?

facts: Mill Proven and Probable reserves of about 1,217 Mt at about 0.19% Cu, 0.22 g/t Au and 0.021% Mo (plus about 210 Mt heap-leach reserve)
After-tax NPV8 of about C$2,334 million and after-tax IRR of 18.1%
Initial capital of about C$3.62 billion
From the 2022 NI 43-101 feasibility study (M3)

questions.question: What did Northcliff's updated feasibility study for the Sisson tungsten-molybdenum project show?

facts: Proven and Probable reserves of 276.8 Mt at 0.075% WO3 and 0.023% Mo
Post-tax NPV8 of about C$6,915 million and IRR of 49.8%
Initial capital of about C$1,528 million
Feasibility study update filed in 2026

questions.question: What are the key outcomes of the definitive feasibility study for the Moblan lithium project?

facts: Probable Mineral Reserve of 34.5 Mt at 1.36% Li2O
Post-tax NPV8 of about C$2.2 billion and post-tax IRR of 34.4%
About 300,000 tpa of 6% spodumene concentrate over a 21-year life of mine
Total capex about C$962.5 million

questions.question: What did Defense Metals' pre-feasibility study for the Wicheeda rare earth project find?

facts: After-tax NPV8 of about $1.0 billion (pre-tax about $1.8 billion)
After-tax IRR of about 18.9% (pre-tax 24.6%)
Initial capital of about $1.4 billion
15-year open-pit mine life feeding a 5,000 tpd flotation plant

questions.question: What are the reserves and economics of Generation Mining's Marathon copper-palladium project?

facts: Proven and Probable reserves of about 128.3 Mt at 0.64 g/t Pd and 0.21% Cu
After-tax NPV6 of about C$1.07 billion and IRR of 28% at 3-year trailing prices
Initial capital of about C$992 million
Mine life of about 12.5 to 13 years (2025 feasibility study update)

questions.question: What did Elevra's pre-feasibility study for the North American Lithium expansion in Quebec find?

facts: Ore reserves of 47.2 Mt at 1.12% Li2O (0.2 Mt Proven and 47.0 Mt Probable)
Post-tax NPV8 of about C$3,218 million for the expansion case, an incremental C$943 million over the base case
Expansion-only post-tax IRR of about 49.9% and initial capex of C$366 million
Life of mine of about 20 years
truth.source: Elevra NAL Expansion PFS announcement, 7 Sep 2026
